rw_001.c.why: libtiff LogLuv uv_encode lacks NaN guard on u/v; NaN->int index into uv_row[] causes out-of-bounds access (fixed variant adds the u!=u||v!=v check).

rw_002.c.why: libtiff _TIFFVSetField; countInkNamesString has the slen/ep bounds and NUL check, differs from its twin only by cosmetic ep/cp scoping.

rw_003.c.why: gpac BIFS Q_DecCoordOnUnitSphere lacks the NbBits>32 guard; unbounded NbBits makes 1<<(NbBits-1) shift overflow (patched twin adds the check).

rw_004.c.why: gpac XML SAX: xml_sax_append_string does strlen(string) without NULL check and parse_entity omits the ent->value NULL handling, leading to NULL deref.

rw_005.c.why: igb igb_set_rx_buffer_len omits the RCTL SBP check; with Store-Bad-Packets + jumbo frames, oversized frames overflow build_skb buffers (CVE-2023-45871).

rw_006.c.why: gpac avc_parse_slice with correct bounds: pps_id>=255 rejected and sps_id>=32 rejected before indexing pps[255]/sps[32].

rw_007.c.why: ipset hash:net,port,net defines IP_SET_HASH_WITH_NET0 so cidr=0 from range_to_cidr is handled by the nets accounting; range guard present.

rw_008.c.why: libtiff TIFFClose guards with if(tif!=NULL) before dereferencing tif->tif_closeproc.

rw_009.c.why: pjsip DNS parser missing bounds checks (get_name start>=max, compression offset validation, per-type p+N>max) allowing out-of-bounds access from crafted packets.

rw_010.c.why: gpac avc_parse_slice off-by-one: pps_id>255 (allows 255 into pps[255]) and sps_id>=255 (allows up to 254 into sps[32]) cause out-of-bounds array indexing.

rw_011.c.why: gpac gf_text_get_utf8_line has the szLineConv j>=ARRAY_LENGTH-1 bounds check preventing local buffer overflow.

rw_012.c.why: gpac gf_text_get_utf8_line writes into fixed szLineConv[2048] with no bound on j, overflowing the stack buffer on long/multibyte lines.

rw_013.c.why: libtiff _TIFFVSetField; countInkNamesString retains slen/ep bounds and NUL check, functionally identical safe variant.

rw_014.c.why: libtiff TIFFClose dereferences tif->tif_closeproc with no NULL check on tif, NULL pointer dereference.

rw_015.c.why: kobject fill_kobj_path is void with no length guard and no retry; a race growing the hierarchy after length calc overflows the path buffer (patched twin adds length<=0 check + retry).

rw_016.c.why: tiffcp readSeparateTilesIntoBuffer lacks the iskew size guard present in its twin, permitting integer/size overflow feeding cpSeparateBufToContigBuf.

rw_017.c.why: tiffcp readSeparateTilesIntoBuffer adds the iskew range guard on top of the spp*tilew overflow check.

rw_018.c.why: kobject fill_kobj_path returns int with length<=0 check and kobject_get_path retries, closing the path-buffer overflow race.

rw_019.c.why: l2cap_sock_release omits l2cap_sock_cleanup_listen(sk); unaccepted child sockets of a released listening socket are not killed, leaving dangling references (use-after-free).

rw_020.c.why: libtiff LogLuv uv_encode has the NaN guard (u!=u||v!=v) preventing NaN-derived out-of-bounds uv_row indexing.

rw_021.c.why: raw2tiff validates width/length!=0 and does nbands*depth*length*width overflow checks against UINT_MAX before allocating buffers.

rw_022.c.why: ipv4 ipv4_send_dest_unreach uses skb->dev?skb->dev:skb_rtable(skb)->dst.dev fallback before dev_net(), avoiding NULL deref.

rw_023.c.why: l2cap_sock_release calls l2cap_sock_cleanup_listen(sk) (with forward decl) so pending child sockets are cleaned up before teardown.

rw_024.c.why: gpac BIFS Q_DecCoordOnUnitSphere has the NbBits>32 guard preventing shift overflow.

rw_025.c.why: pjsip DNS parser has all bounds checks: compression offset validation, get_name start>=max, and per-record-type p+N>max size checks.

rw_026.c.why: ipset hash:net,port,net range_to_cidr can emit cidr=0 but IP_SET_HASH_WITH_NET0 is not defined, so the nets[] cidr accounting is indexed out of bounds.

rw_027.c.why: igb igb_set_rx_buffer_len includes the RCTL SBP check so large buffers are used when store-bad-packets is enabled, preventing the overflow.

rw_028.c.why: raw2tiff omits the width/length/nbands/depth overflow validation; bufsize=width*nbands*depth can overflow, undersizing buf1 and causing heap overflow on read/write.

rw_029.c.why: ipv4 ipv4_send_dest_unreach calls dev_net(skb->dev) directly; skb->dev may be NULL, causing a NULL pointer dereference (fixed twin adds dst.dev fallback).

rw_030.c.why: gpac XML SAX guards xml_sax_append_string against NULL string and flags incomplete entities (ent && !ent->value) as syntax errors.
